sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
The project aims to procure specialised truck-mounted Elevated Work Platforms (EWPs), including Hi-rail EWPs, to support inspection, maintenance and asset management activities at the Sydney Harbour Bridge Precinct.
The procurement will enhance safety, improve operational efficiency, reduce reliance on scaffolding, and provide TfNSW with flexible and cost-effective access solution for maintaining critical bridge and rail infrastructure.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
The procurement comprises two separate packages:
> Package A – 1 X 80m Truck-Mounted Elevated Work Platform.
Supply of one truck-mounted EWP capable of accessing the Sydney Harbour Bridge arch, underdeck areas, and other elevated locations within the precinct. The EWP is required to provide a minimum working height of 80 metres, a minimum outreach of 30 metres, and a minimum basket payload of 500 kg. The equipment must be capable of operating within the structural loading limitations of the Sydney Harbour Bridge deck, including specified outrigger footprint and reaction load requirements. A double-articulated boom configuration is preferred to facilitate access to underdeck and restricted areas.
> Package B – 4 X Hi-Rail Truck-Mounted Elevated Work Platforms.
Supply of four Hi-Rail truck-mounted EWPs, comprising two units with a minimum vertical reach of 15 metres and two units with a minimum vertical reach of 20 metres. The EWPs shall be capable of operating on both road and rail networks and be compatible with Sydney Trains infrastructure and track gauge requirements. Each unit shall feature a double articulated boom lift, minimum basket capacity of 300 kg, automatic transmission, and operation.
